purpose: Recover the two compact palette-transition setup variants before the shared palette convergence loop.

shared_body.name: Render_ConvergePaletteWords
shared_body.contract: Uses D0 as the selected palette-word DBF count, compares each source word with the current VDP palette word, adjusts one masked Genesis color component step, and writes the result to VDP.

boundary_basis: Each entry publishes exactly one additional 0x20-byte source pointer and loads the matching DBF word count.
The entries end immediately before the existing Render_ConvergePaletteWords setup instruction at 0x001B293C.
No direct producer is claimed for either compact variant.
